long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: The garden plot is where unknown seeds might grow, and I want to see what is growing there before anyone else does.
The flowers I planted are mine, and I want to know whether they are doing anything without my permission.
Seeds that grow without permission are still a mystery, and the shelf is where mysteries get settled.
I will read about unknown seeds that grow, since nobody has told me how they manage it.
I want a picture of the plant I claimed, kept with my caption on record.
After all that investigating, a patch of sun is the sensible place to rest.

today.reason: The nap is over and my curiosity has turned to the seeds in the garden, so I am changing course to investigate them.
